chunks: Where they will abide for ever, never wanting a change.

key_terms.حِوَلًا: A change or turning (from one place/state to another)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the dwellers of Paradise will not desire a change?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ultimate state of 'Istiqamah' (steadfastness) where the righteous no longer desire any change because their spiritual fulfillment is complete. It reflects the concept of eternal bliss in Jannah, where the soul finds perfect contentment in the presence of Allah, free from the restlessness of worldly desires.
